title: Dependency-clone recipe was underspecified

title: Legacy wrappers and broad reads inflate context

title: External navigation intent needs explicit target identity
reference: FIND.md What should improve 1 and Packet clarity

title: Packet checker misread slash prose and dispatch receipt preceded result inspection
